title: Deucravacitinib in the treatment of psoriasis.
abstract: Psoriasis is a chronic, immune-mediated, skin disease with a significantly negative impact on patients' quality of life. Moderate-to-severe disease often requires systemic therapies and currently available ones still have numerous disadvantages or limitations. Tyrosine kinase 2 (TYK2) mediates immune signaling of IL-12, IL-23, and type I interferons, without interfering with other critical systemic functions. This article aims to review the current knowledge on deucravacitinib, a new oral drug which selectively inhibits TYK2, granting it a low risk of off-target effects.
